obligations.source_text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

bindings.object_phrase: one primary object remains visibly held or worn by its current adult owner: the brass chronometer case stays in the owner's grip and on the orange harness tether
bindings.claim_phrase: another adult makes an overt claim exchange bid or reach toward that same object as the claimant grips the brass chronometer case and points to their own chest
bindings.owner_response_phrase: the current owner pulls protects refuses or withholds the object through action by bracing the case to their torso and pulling the orange tether taut
bindings.geometry_phrase: claimant object and owner form one readable ownership-boundary triangle around the shared brass chronometer case in the airlock
bindings.continuity_phrase: the object never loses continuity with the owner during the claim because its orange coiled tether stays clipped to the owner's harness
